saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.o.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.onWarning.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.o.description: Capture a screenshot on each screen navigation (flow-map entry). Off by default. Gives a discrete snapshot of every screen visited.
saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.o.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.onNavigation.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.c.description: Minimum gap between any two screenshot captures, in milliseconds. Bounds capture rate during error cascades.
saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.c.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.cooldownMs.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.m.description: Maximum screenshots stored per log file. Once reached, further captures are skipped and one warning is written to the output channel.
saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.m.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.maxPerLog.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.s.description: Skip a screenshot whose picture is near-identical to a recent capture. The phone's status bar is excluded from the comparison, so two captures of the same screen that differ only by the clock count as the same picture. Fault (error/warning) and manually-requested captures are never skipped, and an unreadable capture is always kept. Every skip is written to the output channel with its similarity.
saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.s.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.skipNearDuplicates.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.d.description: How alike two captures must be to count as the same picture, from 0.5 to 0.999. Only used when Skip Near Duplicates is on. Lower values skip more.
saropaCapture.integrations.screenshots.d.title: %config.integrations.screenshots.duplicateSimilarity.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.unifiedLog.wr.description: After session end, write basename.unified.jsonl next to the main log: one JSON line per row { "source", "text" } merging main log, .terminal.log, and external sidecars (for sharing or opening one file in the viewer with Sources filter).
saropaCapture.integrations.unifiedLog.wr.title: %config.integrations.unifiedLog.writeAtSessionEnd.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.unifiedLog.ma.description: When writing unified JSONL, max lines per source (main log, terminal, each external); longer inputs are truncated from the tail of that source.
saropaCapture.integrations.unifiedLog.ma.title: %config.integrations.unifiedLog.maxLinesPerSource.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.whe.description: When to capture Linux system logs: only when targeting WSL, on any remote Linux, or always.
saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.whe.title: %config.integrations.linuxLogs.when.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.sou.description: Linux log sources to capture at session end.
saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.sou.title: %config.integrations.linuxLogs.sources.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.lea.description: Minutes before session start to include in log query.
saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.lea.title: %config.integrations.linuxLogs.leadMinutes.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.lag.description: Minutes after session end to include in log query.
saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.lag.title: %config.integrations.linuxLogs.lagMinutes.title%

saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.wsl.description: WSL distribution name (e.g. Ubuntu-22.04). Empty uses the default distribution.
saropaCapture.integrations.linuxLogs.wsl.title: %config.integrations.linuxLogs.wslDistro.title%

saropaCapture.contextWindowSeconds.description: Time window (±seconds) for the Context Popover. When you click 'Show Integration Context' on a log line, the popover shows data from this many seconds before and after the line timestamp.
saropaCapture.contextWindowSeconds.title: %config.contextWindowSeconds.title%

saropaCapture.loki.enabled.description: Enable Export to Loki. When true and pushUrl is set, the 'Export to Loki' command pushes the current log file to Grafana Loki.
saropaCapture.loki.enabled.title: %config.loki.enabled.title%

saropaCapture.loki.pushUrl.description: Loki push API URL (e.g. https://logs-prod-XXX.grafana.net/loki/api/v1/push or http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push). Required when Loki export is enabled.
saropaCapture.loki.pushUrl.title: %config.loki.pushUrl.title%

saropaCapture.replay.defaultMode.description: Default replay mode: use actual line timing when available (timed) or fixed short delay (fast).
saropaCapture.replay.defaultMode.title: %config.replay.defaultMode.title%

saropaCapture.replay.minLineDelayMs.description: Minimum delay between lines during replay (ms). Prevents replay from being too fast.
saropaCapture.replay.minLineDelayMs.title: %config.replay.minLineDelayMs.title%

saropaCapture.replay.maxDelayMs.description: Maximum delay between lines during replay (ms). Caps long gaps so replay does not freeze.
saropaCapture.replay.maxDelayMs.title: %config.replay.maxDelayMs.title%

saropaCapture.sessionListPageSize.description: Logs per page in Project Logs list. Increase to show more per page; decrease if the list feels slow.
saropaCapture.sessionListPageSize.title: %config.sessionListPageSize.title%

saropaCapture.sessionGroups.enabled.description: Automatically group log files captured in the same time window (e.g. Drift Advisor + Logcat + debug session) into a single logical Session in the Logs list. When off, every log file stands alone.
saropaCapture.sessionGroups.enabled.title: Session Groups: Enabled

saropaCapture.sessionGroups.beforeSecond.description: When a debug session starts, claim pre-existing ungrouped log files whose last-write time is within this many seconds BEFORE the start. Catches sidecars that integration providers write a few seconds ahead of the session. Files already in another group are never re-claimed.
saropaCapture.sessionGroups.beforeSecond.title: Session Groups: Before Seconds

saropaCapture.sessionGroups.afterSeconds.description: After a debug session ends, keep the group open for this many seconds and claim any late-written files (e.g. sidecars flushed in the provider's onSessionEnd hook). Files already claimed by a later session's before-window are not stolen back.
saropaCapture.sessionGroups.afterSeconds.title: Session Groups: After Seconds

saropaCapture.reportsKindPatterns.description: Regex patterns (case-insensitive) matched against a log's display name. Matches are classified as reports and folded into a per-day Reports bucket so debug sessions stay scannable. Defaults cover Saropa Lint Report, Json Bundle Audit/Translate, and Audit Matrix; invalid patterns are dropped silently.
saropaCapture.reportsKindPatterns.title: Logs Panel: Reports Kind Patterns

saropaCapture.reportsBucketDefault.description: Default state for the per-day Reports bucket in the Logs panel. "collapsed" shows the bucket folded with a count badge; "expanded" auto-expands every report row inline; "hidden" removes report rows from the panel entirely (they remain on disk).
saropaCapture.reportsBucketDefault.title: Logs Panel: Reports Bucket Default

saropaCapture.controllerNames.description: Display names to treat as Controllers in the Logs panel — the day's tree root that peripheral logs (lint, translate, advisor) nest beneath. Matched case-insensitively. The project's own log is detected automatically by matching the workspace folder name; add entries here only to pin extra controllers or override the automatic choice.
saropaCapture.controllerNames.title: Logs Panel: Controller Names

saropaCapture.newerLogBanner.description: When on, the Logs panel shows a sticky banner above the day list whenever a newer log has arrived since the panel last had focus. Click Open to jump to it; Dismiss to clear the alert.
saropaCapture.newerLogBanner.title: Logs Panel: Newer-Log Banner

saropaCapture.newerLogDot.description: When on, each Logs panel row carries a small blue dot on its icon while the log is newer than the panel's last focus. The dot persists after the banner is dismissed so the user always has a visible cue per row.
saropaCapture.newerLogDot.title: Logs Panel: Newer-Log Dot

saropaCapture.autoSwitchToLatest.description: When on (the default), the viewer automatically switches to the newest log the moment it arrives, so you always follow the most recent run. Turn it off to keep the newer-log banner instead — the viewer then stays on the log you are reading until you click Open.
saropaCapture.autoSwitchToLatest.title: Logs Panel: Always Switch to Latest Log
